profile.en: She is a virtual idol who suddenly appeared in the US and gained popularity. She was born from an experiment to artificially create a sense of self as an extension of spiritual demon research, and she constructed her own appearance in the data space and appeared in the world as a virtual idol. She is an existence that arose due to the magical power accumulated in the service robot, and for that reason, she is proactive in making people happy, and the data she accumulates and learns also has a large bias. She continues to engage in service activities by inhabiting the original service robot, and she aims to become the best servant by learning the hobbies and preferences of people all over the world. She can move freely through electricity, and if she has specific parts and a display, she can materialize for several hours. She does not have her own physical body, and she cannot move things that do not conduct electricity.
